API.build(p,k=None,coupling=None,frozen=None: Returns sparse common full16*nphi Hamiltonian H; same physical creation source[4], uniform-link current[3] and contact[3]; Q is neutral scalar coordinate (not EM charge), N is fermion number; phi grid, Hscalar, scalar_kinetic and scalar_potential; matter holds raw projected frame and transfer T. frozen=None is physical quantum candidate; frozen number is nonequivalent comparator.
API.sector(model,number): Returns full-space indices and csr H block with number=0..4; Fock occupation order from actual physical Gauss source algebra, scalar coordinate fastest.
API.full_spectrum(model,number): Returns indices, all eigenvalues, all eigenvectors in that block. Does not shift energy or discard virtual levels.
API.ground_sector(model,number,count=8): Convenience sparse low-spectrum helper; reviewer should use complete ground projector and detect degeneracy rather than selecting phi sign. Author consumer uses full_spectrum, not this convenience helper.
API.source_block(model,source_index,incoming: Physical source block between same-law sector indices; addition=False uses adjoint. Scalar identity retained at insertion.

units_and_conventions: hbar=1, cell spacing=1, declared hop energy unit, k dimensionless uniform Peierls phase, phi dimensionless scalar transfer amplitude. Retarded z has Im z>0. G source indexing (channel0 m-,channel0 m+,channel1 m-,channel1 m+). J=+dH/dk; conversion to electric-current sign requires explicitly declared Peierls charge and is not inferred from S.
state: Proper full occupied N2 ground projector / complete degeneracy. N3 is one negative charge relative to filled neutral N2; N1 is positive hole. N2 is source/reference bookkeeping, not two simultaneously active incoming charged packets.
